newsitem.title: USA: Resource America stake raised by Bay Pond.
newsitem.headline: Resource America stake raised by Bay Pond.

text.p: A group led by Bay Pond Partners LP said Tuesday it raised its stake in Resource America Inc to 280,800 common shares or 7.91 percent from 6.76 percent held previously.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include the purchase of 40,800 common shares between Dec 2 and Dec 5 at prices ranging from $15.6250 to $17.50 per share.
The group holds the stake for investment purposes.
Bay Pond is a Boston-based investment partnership.
Resource America, based in Philadelphia, is a real-estate mortgage and equipment-lease financing company.
